Mathematics Version 2.0 Level Description

In Level 3, learning in Mathematics builds on each student’s prior learning...

Show more

In Level 3, learning in Mathematics builds on each student’s prior learning and experiences.

Students further develop proficiency and positive dispositions towards mathematics and its use as they:

  • use metric units to measure and compare objects and events
  • become increasingly able to understand that different outcomes can be the results of random processes.
Show less

Mathematics Version 2.0 Content Descriptions

Number

  1. identify, explain and use the properties of odd and even numbers (VC2M3N01)
  2. recognise and represent unit fractions including 12, 110 and \(\frac{1}{4}\) and their multiples in different ways (VC2M3N03)

Algebra

  1. recall and demonstrate proficiency with multiplication facts for 3, 4, 5 and 10 ; extend and apply facts (VC2M3A03)

Mathematics Version 2.0 Achievement Standard

By the end of Level 3, students order and represent natural numbers beyond 10 000.

Students conduct repeated chance experiments and discuss variation in results.
